blurb: East Coast Aero Club provides flight instruction and aircraft rental from three locations in southern New Hampshire and the Greater Boston area. They offer training for private pilot license, instrument rating, commercial pilot, and other advanced certifications. Experienced instructors and a modern fleet support hands-on training and real-world experience.
